title: Military and Industrial Land Development
intro: Hey, you’re the visitor staying up the street, right? Is your water tasting funny too? Since I moved to this part of town the tap’s run grey some mornings, and last week it smelled like a garage.
My wife’s cousin at the clinic says kids from these six streets keep coming in with stomach aches.
There’s so much up that hill, the plant, the base, the fuel tanks, and nobody tells us anything. Honestly I’ve started thinking the only fix is to move.
What can we actually do to make this safer for my family and the neighbours?
